verdict.rationale: Gemini's own Privacy Hub documents that you can export your information, linking to Google Takeout, and separately lets you delete your Gemini Apps activity, which supports leaving. The evidence is a single thin mention, though: it doesn't say what data the export covers or what formats it uses. Missing for 10: confirmation that the export uses open, documented formats; confirmation that it covers all Gemini data (chats, Gems, notebooks, uploads); hands-on or independent evidence of a completed export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: You can request the removal of content under our policies or applicable laws. You can also export your information.
You can review your prompts, delete your Gemini Apps activity, and turn off Keep Activity in My Activity at any time.
